scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Dependent Children of Widows and Destitute Women, Chandigarh
department: Social Welfare, Women & Child Development, Chandigarh Administration
benefit_summary: Rs. 1,000 per month per child, up to two children

citation.quote: The applicant should be a widow/destitute woman or with a dependent child/children.
If parents of the child/children have died, the assistance will be provided to the legal guardian.
The age of the child/children should be less than or equal to 18 years.
The widow/destitute woman or the legal guardian should be a resident of the UT of Chandigarh for more than 3 years.
The child should not be in receipt of family pension from any State/Central Govt.
Children who have been given institutional care by government/NGO shall not be eligible for financial assistance.

unmapped_conditions.text: Applicant may be a destitute woman
unmapped_conditions.quote: The applicant should be a widow/destitute woman
